keywords: 多方区块构建 MPBC 上线
EIP-7999 多维费用市场模拟
summary: EF Protocol 在 r/ethereum 办 AMA，问题涉及客户端资金、frame 交易对后量子的意义、单槽最终性等。Blockspace Forum 的多方区块构建（MPBC）上线，最有价值的区块可以加入多个构建者的交易。binji 继续呼吁把 quick slots（EIP-8198）纳入 Hegotá，Prysm 发布 Hegotá 分级榜。

items.title: binji：MPBC 让多个构建者一起填同一个区块
items.note: 21:01，以前只有一个构建者挑选交易，漏掉就要等下一块。据 Ethereal news #40，Blockspace Forum 的 MPBC 已上线，最有价值的区块会加入多个构建者的交易，初期只允许追加。
items.title_en: binji: with MPBC, multiple builders help fill the same block
items.note_en: 21:01, where before one builder picked the transactions and a missed one had to wait. According to Ethereal news #40, Blockspace Forum's MPBC is live, expanding the most valuable block with transactions from multiple builders, initially append only.

summary_en: EF Protocol held an AMA on r/ethereum, with questions on client funding, what frame transactions mean for post-quantum, single slot finality and more. Blockspace Forum's multi-party block construction (MPBC) went live, letting the most valuable block take transactions from several builders. binji kept pushing to include quick slots (EIP-8198) in Hegotá, and Prysm published its Hegotá tier list.
